name: 123-3D (123inkt house brand)
summary: House-brand ('huismerk') filament of Dutch online retailer 123inkt, sold through the 123-3d.nl web shop it launched in 2015 (operated by 123 3D B.V., Almere). The broad range covers PLA in 1.75/2.85 mm including the Jupiter series, high-speed, Tough, chameleon and glow PLA, plus ABS, PETG, ASA, TPE, HIPS, cleaning and 3D-pen filament. The shop is also an official Real Filament dealer, but the house-brand extruder is not named.

oem_relationships.notes: 123-3d.nl was launched in 2015 by 123inkt.nl (https://www.123-3d.nl/news/123inktnl+lanceert+gespecialiseerde+3D-webwinkel+123-3Dnl-7.html); the site carries a 'powered by 123inkt' logo and listings on both sites are marked 'huismerkproduct'. Operating entity: 123 3D B.V., Koningsbeltweg 52, 1329 AK Almere.
The site calls it 'our own house-brand filament' with no maker named; 123inkt is a retailer. A search summary said 'produced within Europe', unconfirmed for the house brand.
123-3D is an official dealer of the separate Real Filament brand (https://www.123-3d.nl/page/realfilament.html). This is NOT evidence that Real makes 123-3D house-brand filament.

provenance.conflicts: Identity as 123inkt house brand is medium-high; manufacturer unknown (low). City differs between sources (Almere vs Nederhorst den Berg). 'Produced within Europe' is unconfirmed.
